name: Preserving Knowledge
summary: In Southshore, Loremaster Dibbs sends you into the Ruins of Alterac to save books from the ogres who have settled there. One worn leather volume matters most: it holds The Arm of Gri'lek, a work of ancient troll lore.

sections.title: Books in Ogre Hands
sections.body: Loremaster Dibbs fears for the books left in the Ruins of Alterac, now home to ogres. You search for the tomes they have looted and recover what you can. Dibbs would climb into the mountains to search too, but fears old bones would not survive the journey.

sections.title: The Arm of Gri'lek
sections.body: Among the tomes, Loremaster Dibbs most wants a worn leather book containing The Arm of Gri'lek. Dibbs is bent on learning its ancient troll lore. The Ruins of Alterac were the last known home of an intact copy.

faq.q: Who offers this quest and where are they?
faq.answer: Loremaster Dibbs offers it in Southshore.

faq.q: What specific book is Loremaster Dibbs searching for?
faq.answer: Dibbs seeks the worn leather volume containing The Arm of Gri'lek, a work of ancient troll lore.

aliases: where is the arm of gri'lek
faq.answer: The books are in the Ruins of Alterac, where ogres have settled and looted tomes. The ruins were the last known home of an intact copy of The Arm of Gri'lek.

faq.q: Why does Dibbs want books from Alterac?
aliases: what does dibbs want with books
faq.answer: Dibbs fears what the ogres may be doing to the precious books in the ruins and wants to save what can be recovered. Dibbs wants The Arm of Gri'lek most, to learn its ancient troll lore.
